name: loremetry
description: Loremetry - Desktop app & Web API for manuscript analysis

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --workspace=ui && npm install --workspace=web-api
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=web-api" "npm run dev --workspace=ui" "cargo tauri dev"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=web-api && npm run build --workspace=ui && cargo tauri build
